title: God's Numbers — Counting Through Scripture
description: Let's see what you learned about the numbers 1 through 5 and their Bible stories!

questions.question: How many gods are there?
questions.explanation: There is only ONE God! The Bible says, 'The LORD our God, the LORD is one' (Deuteronomy 6:4).

questions.question: How many stone tablets did God give to Moses?
questions.explanation: God gave Moses TWO stone tablets with the Ten Commandments written on them (Exodus 31:18).

questions.question: How many days was Jonah inside the big fish?
questions.explanation: Jonah was inside the great fish for THREE days and three nights (Jonah 1:17).

questions.question: How many Gospels are in the Bible?
questions.explanation: There are FOUR Gospels in the Bible: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John.

questions.question: How many loaves of bread did the little boy give to Jesus?
questions.explanation: The little boy had FIVE small loaves of bread, and Jesus used them to feed over 5,000 people (John 6:9-11)!
